info.title: Agent API
info.description: Single-operator agent. No authentication: reachability over the tailnet is the only access control. A WebSocket at /ws streams transcript entries, token deltas, job ticks, breaker changes, and `working` / `idle` as a session's turns start and the last queued one ends; every state change delivered there is also retrievable from the endpoints below.

get.summary: List sessions, most recently active first.

post.summary: Create a session with its configuration.

model.description: Omitted, it is inherited from the seed session, then from the most recently used one, then from the configured default.

enabled_tools.description: Tool names defined in this session's prompt. Three states: omit it to inherit, send null for every one, send a list for exactly those.

enabled_skills.description: Skill names indexed in this session's prompt. Three states: omit it to inherit, send null for every one, send a list for exactly those.

from.description: Seed the new session's configuration from that session.

post.description: A session's model, tools, and skills are fixed once it exists. They are chosen here, or inherited, and afterwards change only by rotating.

get.description: A session is never superseded, so an identifier always addresses the conversation it named.

patch.summary: Update the title, or when the conversation compacts.

title.description: A new title. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; a blank title is refused.

compact_at_tokens.description: When this conversation compacts. Not part of the configuration: no prompt reads it, so it can change at any point.

keep_verbatim_tokens.description: How much of the newest conversation a compaction keeps word for word. At most half of compact_at_tokens, as it stands after this request.

409.description: Refused: the body carried model, enabled_tools, enabled_skills, granted_env, or persona. A session's configuration is fixed for its life; POST /sessions/{id}/fork to copy the conversation into a new session under a new one. Nothing in the request is applied, a title sent alongside included.

400.description: Refused: a blank title, compact_at_tokens below 2,000, a negative keep_verbatim_tokens, or a tail more than half the threshold. Nothing in the request is applied.

patch.description: This endpoint changes nothing that shapes the system prompt, so it can never invalidate a cached prefix. Model, tools, and skills are not accepted here at all: they are fixed for the life of a session and move only through a rotation.

delete.summary: Delete a session, its transcript, and its jobs.

get.summary: Read transcript entries. Returns the complete stored record, including entries not sent to the model.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Read from this index on: the entries after the first n. Entry n is at index n, so a page catching up passes how many it holds; from the end or past it, the answer is empty.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Entry sequence number to page backwards from.

post.summary: Stop the turn this session is running. A turn runs for as long as its work takes; this ends one where it is, and the transcript says it was stopped.

409.description: This session is not working on anything.

post.summary: Mark this session read through an entry. What is unread is the assistant messages after the point read through; a point earlier than the one recorded changes nothing.

through.description: Sequence number of the last entry shown. Absent, the read covers every entry the session has.

200.description: Recorded. Says whether the read cleared anything unread; a read that cleared nothing changes nothing the session list shows, and no page is told the list moved.

cleared.description: True when an assistant message that was unread is now read.

post.summary: Send a user message. Queues behind any turn already running in this session.

get.summary: Full-text search across transcripts, or one transcript.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to look for. Each word matches as a prefix, and punctuation is looked for as written rather than read as query syntax: follow-up, notes.md, and AND are all searched for as they stand. A query holding no letter or digit matches nothing.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Search this session only. Omitted, every session is searched.

200.description: Matches; an empty list when nothing matches.

seq.description: The entry's sequence number in its transcript.

snippet.description: The words around the match, each match in square brackets.

type.description: The entry's type: message, event, compaction.

role.description: For a message: user, assistant, or tool.

compacted.description: The session's newest compaction covers this entry, so the agent no longer sees it.

get.description: Each word of q is FTS5 syntax. Entries a compaction covers are still found, and say so.

post.summary: Create a job attached to a session.

422.description: Rejected: the schedule, the prompt, or after_acting is not valid.

delete.summary: Delete every finished job, with its run log. The only bulk delete: status must be `done`, so nothing still scheduled can be removed this way.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The state to delete. Only `done` is accepted.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Clear only this session's finished jobs.

400.description: The status was missing or was not `done`; nothing was deleted.

delete.summary: Delete a job. Its run log goes with it.

get.summary: List loaded tools and any that failed validation.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Report each tool's enabled state for this session.

post.summary: Validate and register tools from disk. Previously loaded tools keep working if a new one fails.

post.description: The operator writes skills; the agent cannot. The file is stored outside the image, so it survives a deployment. A name that collides with a skill shipping in the image is refused.

409.description: Refused, with what is on disk unchanged: the name is already taken — by one of the operator's, or by one that ships with the agent — or a required field is missing. A skill is changed by a PUT to its own address.

put.summary: Replace a skill the operator wrote.

409.description: Refused: the skill ships in the image, or a required field is missing.

delete.summary: Delete a skill the operator wrote.

409.description: Refused: the skill ships in the image, or there is no such skill.

get.summary: List personas. The built-in one is always among them.

post.description: A persona is the opening section of the system prompt. A session that chooses one gets it in place of the built-in persona entirely.

409.description: Refused, with what is on disk unchanged: the name is already taken — by one of the operator's, or by one that ships with the agent — or a required field is missing. A persona is changed by a PUT to its own address.

put.summary: Replace a persona the operator wrote.

409.description: Refused: the persona is the built-in one, or a required field is missing.

delete.summary: Delete a persona the operator wrote.

409.description: Refused: the persona is the built-in one, or there is no such persona.

post.summary: Upload a file into the workspace.
post.description: Maximum 250 MB per file. Uploads belong to the workspace and are deleted with the session that referenced them.

get.summary: Models that support tool calling, with what one is chosen by: price, context, accepted input, and benchmark indices. Cached from OpenRouter, refreshed daily. ?q= narrows to models whose id or name contains every term.

intelligence_index.description: Artificial Analysis intelligence index as the gateway reports it. Absent when unmeasured, never zero.

coding_index.description: Artificial Analysis coding index as the gateway reports it. Absent when unmeasured, never zero.

agentic_index.description: Artificial Analysis agentic index as the gateway reports it. Absent when unmeasured, never zero.

get.summary: What a new conversation starts from: the model last chosen, else the most recent session's, else a fallback. A model is chosen by creating a session that names it or forking onto a different one.
The variable names a session could be granted. Names only, never values; leaves out OPENROUTER_API_KEY, what every tool already receives, and what each call overwrites.

from_env_file.description: Written in the agent's .env rather than inherited by the process.

get.summary: Credit, usage, and scheduler health. Answers at once and never waits on OpenRouter: it is the first request a page coming back makes and the container's health check. The credit is the figure last heard from OpenRouter, absent until it first has been, and fetched again in the background once it is an hour old; a status event over the socket says when a fresher figure has arrived.

breaker_probe_at.description: When the next held job will be retried to test whether the breaker can close.

post.summary: Continue this conversation in a new session.

archive.description: Archive the predecessor and move its jobs to the successor. False leaves both live, which is a fork.

enabled_tools.description: Tool names for the successor. Three states: omit it to keep the predecessor's, send null for every one, send a list for exactly those.

enabled_skills.description: Skill names for the successor. Three states: omit it to keep the predecessor's, send null for every one, send a list for exactly those.

post.description: Rotation, fork, resume, and reconfiguration are one operation. The successor is seeded with the predecessor's summary and the most recent complete turns that fit the carry-over budget, and starts under the configuration given here, defaulting to the predecessor's. Both entries name what changed.

get.summary: A job's run log: every wake, what came of it, and what was said. Newest first.

due_at.description: When it was scheduled for. Differs from at when the host slept or the session was busy.

message.description: What the agent said, why the check said no, or what went wrong.

post.summary: Put one message to several models at once. Each model answers in a fork of this conversation, carrying its transcript and a copy of its working directory. This session is not sent the message and records one compare event naming the candidates.

text.description: The message put to every model.

models.description: Two or more model identifiers. One candidate is created per entry, in order.

201.description: The candidates, in the order the models were given.

comparison.description: Identifies this comparison; every candidate carries it until one is kept.

400.description: Fewer than two models, or no message.

post.summary: Decide a comparison in favour of this candidate. Every other candidate of the same comparison is stopped and deleted, transcript and working directory with it. This session carries on as an ordinary conversation.

200.description: The kept session, and what was deleted.

deleted.description: The candidates that were deleted, named by model and identifier.

409.description: This session is not a candidate of an undecided comparison.

post.summary: Compact now rather than at the threshold.
post.description: Takes its place on the session's queue behind any turn in progress, so it never folds a conversation mid-turn. While it runs the session reports itself working and can be stopped like a turn. Answers when it is done.

200.description: Compacted. The compaction entry is in the transcript.

409.description: Nothing to compact: everything since the last compaction fits in keep_verbatim_tokens. No model call is made and nothing is written.

500.description: The summariser failed or wrote a summary no smaller than what it covered. An error event records it and the conversation continues uncompacted.

enabled_tools.description: Tools callable in this session. Null means all. A new session inherits the most recently used set.

enabled_skills.description: Skills indexed in this session. Null means every skill that is on by default. A new session inherits the most recently used set.

read_through.description: Sequence number of the last entry the operator was shown. Only moves forward.

unread.description: Assistant messages after read_through. Derived, not stored.

context_used.description: Projected tokens against the model's window.

summary.description: Rolling summary of this session, updated incrementally. Not part of this session's prompt; used to seed a successor.

continued_from.description: The session this one was seeded from, by rotation, fork, or resume.

rotate_at_tokens.description: Projected size at which this session rotates into a successor. Chosen for cost, not for the model's context limit.

carry_over_tokens.description: Token budget for complete recent turns copied into a successor alongside the summary. Default 5000.

continued_by.description: The session that succeeded this one. Following continued_by to its end gives the live session of this chain.

working_seconds.description: How long a turn has been running or queued in this session, in seconds; absent when none is. Elapsed rather than a start time, so a client clock that disagrees still counts correctly.

comparison.description: The comparison this session is a candidate of, while that comparison is undecided. Absent on every other session: keeping one candidate clears it and deletes the rest.

compact_at_tokens.description: Projected size at which this conversation compacts. Default 40,000. Changeable at any time with PATCH; a fork inherits it.

keep_verbatim_tokens.description: How much of the newest conversation a compaction keeps word for word. Default 10,000; at most half of compact_at_tokens.

Entry.description: A transcript entry. Entries of type event are shown to the user and never sent to the model.

job_id.description: Set when this entry was produced by a job.

status.description: Tick outcome. Consecutive entries sharing job_id and status collapse in the projection. For a check tick this reflects whether the check matched; for a model tick, whether notify was called.

sections.description: Present on a prompt entry: the system prompt as sent, split into readable sections.

schedule.description: An interval (2m), a cron expression (0 9 * * *), or an RFC 3339 instant.

check.description: A shell command. Exit status zero means the condition is met. Omit for a job whose condition requires judgement, in which case the model runs every tick and signals by calling notify.

prompt.description: What the agent is asked when the job runs.

schedule.description: An interval (2m), a cron expression (0 9 * * *), or an RFC 3339 instant.

check.description: A shell command. Exit status zero means the condition is met. Omit for a job whose condition requires judgement, in which case the model runs every tick and signals by calling notify.

prompt.description: What the agent is asked when the job runs.

parameters.description: JSON Schema exposed to the model.

enabled.description: Whether this tool is callable in the requested session.

reach.description: What the tool may touch, from the policy the sandbox applies. Absent for a builtin, which runs inside the agent.

ports.description: TCP ports the tool may connect to, the tool API's included.

operator_port.description: The interface's port, which no tool may connect to.

description.description: One line. Only this and the name reach the system prompt.

default_enabled.description: Whether a session that did not choose its skills has this one. False when the frontmatter says default: off.

enabled.description: With ?session_id=, whether that session has it; otherwise the default.

editable.description: Whether the operator wrote this one. A skill that ships in the image is read-only.

name.description: Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. It is the identifier and the file name.

description.description: One line. This and the name are all that reach the system prompt.

body.description: The prose the agent reads when it opens the skill.

default_enabled.description: Whether a session that did not choose its skills has this one. Defaults to true.

description.description: One line, so personas can be told apart when a conversation is configured.

editable.description: Whether the operator wrote this one. The built-in persona is read-only.

body.description: The whole opening section of the system prompt for a session that chooses this persona.
